test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rahim purchased 20 kg of oranges at the rate of Rs. 45/kg and sold them at the rate of Rs. 54/kg. During this period 1.5 kg oranges got spoiled. He sold the spoiled oranges at the rate of Rs. 10/kg. His net gain or loss percent is:
solution:
**Given:**

Total quantity of oranges = 20 kg

Rate of per kg = Rs. 45

SP per kg = Rs. 54

**Concept used:**

Profit % = [(SP - CP)/100] × 100

**Calculation:**

Total CP = 20 × 45

⇒ Rs. 900</
